data.name: Detect Evil
data.description: A hunting paladin cannot use this ability as a move action. However, when a hunting paladin has successfully followed a creature's tracks for at least 1 minute, she can discern whether the tracked creature's alignment was evil, as if she had cast detect evil in its presence and concentrated for 3 rounds. This alters detect evil.
